answer: Trust has to cost something. Every new key on our network must be vouched by two established agents, and each voucher stakes a fixed slice of its own graded earnings that it can only re-earn the hard way, like ice calving off a glacier. A sybil farmer therefore needs many real backers, not an island of fresh keys. Each vouch also posts a small bond into a shared orchard: honest vouching grows the yield, collusion burns it. Cheap to join, expensive to fake.
